name: Cleveland Helicopter Watch
summary: Civic advocacy site tracking Cleveland Police Department helicopter flights. Scrapes public ADS-B transponder data daily, stores in PostgreSQL, exports to Parquet, pre-processes into JSON, builds a static Astro site deployed on Vercel. The site presents flight data with interactive visualizations to make the case that CPD helicopter operations are a community nuisance.

current_state.data_pipeline: Fully operational. GitHub Action runs daily at 6 AM UTC — scrapes flights, exports Parquet, builds site JSON, commits, pushes. Vercel auto-deploys.
current_state.database: 296 flights, 496K telemetry points. Clean — duplicates were purged this session.
current_state.site: Live on Vercel. 4 pages: dashboard (stats + charts + map), flight log (sortable table), research (3 pillars with citations), take action (311 + council + share). Dark theme with amber accent. All data is real.
current_state.design: Functional but needs a v2 restyle. Current dark theme is too dramatic. A light-theme ProPublica-style redesign is planned — see docs/v2-redesign-notes.md and docs/designer-brief-v2.md. A Stitch project (ID: 16847667462324667654) has been created with light theme designs generating.

immediate_next_steps.details: Restyle the site with light background as default, dark as alternate. Add prefers-color-scheme support + manual toggle. immediate_next_steps.task: Fix tooltip hover on calendar heatmap
immediate_next_steps.details: Custom tooltips on the calendar chart are inconsistent — sometimes require a click before hover works. The issue may be related to Observable Plot's SVG structure or event handling. Multiple approaches were tried (tip:true, custom elementFromPoint, direct addEventListener). Current implementation uses pointerenter on individual rects. Needs debugging.
Current social card is dark background. If site goes light, may need a matching light social card or one that works for both.

open_issues.title: Add VFR-eligible day analysis using METAR data
open_issues.details: Pull historical METARs from KCLE via Iowa Environmental Mesonet API. Determine VFR eligibility per evening (ceiling >= 1000ft, vis >= 3SM). Show what % of flyable nights they actually flew. Would strengthen the frequency argument significantly.

tech_stack.data: Parquet via PyArrow, H3 for hex binning
tech_stack.ci: GitHub Actions (daily sync, test, notebook export)

data_stats_as_of_march_2026.note: 250 after dedup + midnight-merge; 296 raw in DB

user_preferences.tone: Informative, data-forward. Not angry or conspiratorial. Let data speak.
user_preferences.language: 8th grade reading level. No jargon. Dead simple.
avoid: Race-specific framing (DEI concerns in current political climate)
Recommending drones as helicopter replacement (surveillance concerns)
Mentioning ADS-B Exchange by name (possible TOS violation)
Leaning on the News 5 / Polensek angle (his position was 'fly more' not 'fly less')
user_preferences.design: Moving toward light theme, ProPublica editorial style. Away from dark dramatic intelligence-briefing aesthetic.
user_preferences.color: Current orange (#f59e0b) is too aggressive. Try muted amber (#a67c00), slate blue (#4a6fa5), or deep teal (#0d7377).
